name: Goat
siboNotes: Plain goat meat is naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated. Avoid marinades containing high FODMAP ingredients like garlic or onion.
preparationTips: Use FODMAP-friendly herbs like oregano, thyme, and rosemary for flavoring
Marinate with garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic
Cook with ginger, cumin, or paprika for added flavor without FODMAPs
Pair with low FODMAP vegetables for balanced meals
